proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Lobbying Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing Alphabet's direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots lobbying policies, payments, recipients, and oversight decision-making.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Congruency Report
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests report analyzing whether voluntary partnerships with organizations like WEF and CFR are congruent with shareholder fiduciary interests.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.
